examples.text_en: They were reverent in the old church.
examples.text_zh: 他们在那座古老的教堂里满怀敬意。

examples.text_en: He did talk reverently about the old king.
examples.text_zh: 他恭敬地谈起那位老国王。

examples.text_en: They did stand reverently in the old church.
examples.text_zh: 他们恭敬地站在那座古老的教堂里。

examples.text_en: He was in a reverie in the dark room.
examples.text_zh: 他在昏暗的房间里陷入了沉思。

examples.text_en: The old song did bring a reverie to the group.
examples.text_zh: 这首老歌让这群人陷入了遐思。

examples.text_en: The old plan was reversible and very good.
examples.text_zh: 那个旧计划是可逆的，而且很好。

examples.text_en: They did want a reversible deal with the company.
examples.text_zh: 他们想和这家公司达成一项可撤销的协议。

examples.text_en: The reversion of the old law was a big change.
examples.text_zh: 旧法律的恢复是一次重大变动。

examples.text_en: They did talk about the reversion of the whole system.
examples.text_zh: 他们谈论了整个系统的恢复。

examples.text_en: The old system will revert to the first way.
examples.text_zh: 旧系统会恢复到最初的方式。

examples.text_en: He did revert to his old way of thinking.
examples.text_zh: 他又恢复了自己旧的思维方式。

examples.text_en: The reviewer did talk about the new film.
examples.text_zh: 那位评论者谈论了这部新电影。

examples.text_en: She is a well known reviewer in this city.
examples.text_zh: 她是这座城市里一位有名的评论家。

examples.text_en: They will revile the old man in the town.
examples.text_zh: 他们会在镇上辱骂那位老人。

examples.text_en: He did revile the whole group in the end.
examples.text_zh: 他最后辱骂了整个团体。

examples.text_en: They will revise the old book for the group.
examples.text_zh: 他们会为这个团体校订那本旧书。

examples.text_en: He did revise the whole plan in a week.
examples.text_zh: 他在一周内修正了整个计划。

examples.text_en: The revitalization of the old town was a big job.
examples.text_zh: 复兴这座老镇是项大工程。

examples.text_en: They did work on the revitalization of the whole area.
examples.text_zh: 他们致力于整个地区的复苏。

examples.text_en: They will revitalize the old town next year.
examples.text_zh: 他们明年会让这座老镇恢复生机。

examples.text_en: He did revitalize the whole group in a week.
examples.text_zh: 他在一周内让整个团体重新焕发活力。

examples.text_en: The revival of the old song was a big success.
examples.text_zh: 这首老歌的复兴大获成功。

examples.text_en: They did enjoy the revival at the old church.
examples.text_zh: 他们很喜欢在那座古老教堂里举行的复兴活动。

examples.text_en: The court will revoke the old law next year.
examples.text_zh: 法院明年将废除这条旧法律。

examples.text_en: They did revoke the deal in the same week.
examples.text_zh: 他们在同一周内撤销了那笔交易。

examples.text_en: The revolutionary did talk to the whole group.
examples.text_zh: 那位革命者和整个团体谈了话。

examples.text_en: He is a well known revolutionary in this country.
examples.text_zh: 他是这个国家里一位有名的革命者。
